caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, cast-iron stove standing on a curved, four-legged base. The stove features detailed engravings and decorative panels, with the name “JOS. BELL & CO.” visible on the upper front section. The stove door is open, revealing burning logs with visible flames and glowing embers inside. The flames are rendered in shades of orange, yellow, and red, contrasting with the dark gray and black hues of the stove itself. The open doors are hinged on either side, each with raised patterns and a round handle. Vertical grillwork is visible below the firebox, and the overall composition is centered on a plain, cream-colored background with a thin rectangular border. The drawing style emphasizes the metallic texture and fine details of the stove’s design, while the fire inside adds warmth and color to the central part of the image.
title: Franklin Stove
